about: Issue parity cases on the fixture registry (server/testdata/registry, the département of Ogooué-Létili, 2OL). Each expected value was computed by the N-Ways issuer (internal/addressing/ga) from the same register and the same issued codes; the server must reproduce every one. issue: points posted in order to POST /v1/codes; insert: one new compound in a given area; places: zone, code area, nearest numbered area, spot code (also for points in no outline, SPEC 5; none where the point is refused) and Plus Code of random points.
